title: Generated-system runner: previous-slot binding, sampled views and derived allocations
body: The GPU system manifest already carries each texture argument's slot (single/current/previous), the sampled form with its samplerBinding, and the texture allocations (slots, usage). GeneratedSystemStage.h's SchemaResourceRegistry keys only {kind, member}, ignores slot and samplerBinding, and allocates nothing, so the TAA kernel system (Previous[] history, Sample() neighbourhood) cannot be wired: its ResolvedRadiance history pair and a sampler would need hand nodes. Make the registry slot-aware, bind sampled image + sampler from the manifest, and allocate manifest allocations no hand pass provides. Unblocks op-aataa S4 part 2 (taa compiled). tier:luna: several files in one runner, a fixture test.

title: DescriptorSetNode binds every SAMPLED_IMAGE as SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
body: HandleSampledImage (DescriptorSetNode.cpp ~605-650) hard-codes VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL, but storage images in this compute graph stay GENERAL and the kernel manifest declares a sampled read of such an image as layout GENERAL (accessKind ComputeSampledReadGeneral). Binding one would be a layout mismatch. Take the layout from the binding's declared access (manifest layout) instead of a constant. tier:haiku: one function plus a test.

title: PrevCameraConfig is the reconstruction record: rename it and drop the dead Z
body: PrevCameraConfig now carries the previous view-projection, the primary jitter, the input extent and the AA history-weight ceiling (op-aataa). Its name says camera; its reconstructionSampling.z (pick ray-cone coefficient) is written 0 and unused since the second pick trace was removed (PrevCameraConfigNode.cpp). Rename to a reconstruction record and replace the Float3 with the jitter pair. tier:haiku: mechanical rename across schema, node, two shaders and two tests.

title: AA module settings sit in RenderPathConfig until the R675 settings record exists
body: R675.1/.2 want module settings declared beside the module (<Name>Settings.cs singleton KindSchema) and read per variant from a canonical JSON by generated native code. Neither the module directory form nor the reader exists on the wave, so op-aataa put the AA provider request (antiAliasing) and the TAA history-weight ceiling in VulkanGraphApplication::RenderPathConfig, beside the upscaler request. Move both to AntiAliasingSettings once the R675 infrastructure (op-modoptions, FSR3 first) lands. tier:luna once R675 S1 exists.

title: Exposure meter is a hand pass reading the scene radiance by provider name
body: R676.1 places TAA before the meter, so the meter must read state:frame-targets.ResolvedRadiance. ExposureMeter.comp is a hand stage bound through sceneProviders by the name sceneRadianceHistoryOutput (BuildRenderGraph.cpp exposure block); only the generated tone map binds by schema identity. With  the two are the same image; with  the meter would need a second hand provider. Convert the meter (and reduce) to kernel systems reading ResolvedRadiance; this also removes the ExposureMeterState [GpuStruct] mirror (op-rbridge consolidation 3). tier:luna.
